title: Bad Status
text: “Woooooooooooooo!”
“Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”

My father charged toward Itsuki, holding his shield out in front of him. At the same time, Itsuki used Skills to take a step back while firing an arrow from his bow. The arrow flew in a straight line toward my father, but he caught it with one hand and stopped it.
“What!?”

Itsuki let out a cry of shock. However, he immediately regained his composure and fired arrow after arrow in rapid succession. There were so many that even my Father seemed unable to fend them all off.
“Air Strike Shield!”

My Father cast Air Strike Shield before the arrows could hit, nullifying them. Itsuki, whose main strategy is long-range attacks, and my Father, whose job is to protect others, have different roles. Under normal circumstances, Father’s attacks probably wouldn’t even leave a scratch on Itsuki. However, he’s always been one to try all sorts of things—even when he fought me, he used a variety of tactics.

Hiding balloons under his cloak and making them bite me was a stroke of genius. In online gaming terms, that’s the behavior of a “monster player killer,” but for Father, who lacks means to attack other players, it was the perfect strategy. It seems my Father isn’t hiding anything like that under his cloak this time. I’m really curious to see what Motoyasu is up to—I’m fascinated by Father’s ingenuity.
“Is shooting arrows while running away all you can do? You’re such a noob. That might be a decent attack in a console game, but it really shows your true colors, Itsuki.”

“Noob”… I feel like I’ve heard that term before. I believe there are some online games where players enjoy gunfights. I think it was a derogatory term used for those players who never step forward and just keep shooting from the rear in those gunfight games.
“You said it! Take this! Bunker Shot!”

Itsuki, his anger flaring at his father-in-law’s provocation, closed in and unleashed a skill aimed at his father-in-law’s chest. Wasn’t that a skill whose power increases the closer you get? Well, given Itsuki’s playstyle, it’s probably not a skill he uses very often.
Also, it’s likely an early-game skill. I’d guess it’s meant for emergency use when an enemy gets too close. I recall it evolving further later on.

In the future, it became a dead skill that he never used at all. Back when I thought of it as just a game, it was considered moderately strong if you specialized your stats for it, but people used to say, “If you’re going to do that with a bow-based class, you might as well play a melee class.” However, if you’re soloing as an archer, it’s a skill worth picking up. Well, we heroes can use it anytime as long as we unlock the equipment, of course.
A thud echoed as the impact struck my Father.
“…Hmm. It’s not unbearable.”
With a calm expression, Father completely absorbed Itsuki’s attack.
“Wha… not a single scratch!?”

Itsuki, who had been smiling, looked completely speechless. After all, there’s a world of difference in strength between my Father and Itsuki right now. He’s put every single enhancement method I taught him into practice. On the other hand, even if Itsuki had mastered all the Four Saints’ enhancement methods, he still wouldn’t stand a chance against my Father, who hasn’t neglected his training.
“Next… it’s my turn.”
“What do you think you can do with that shield?!”
With a firm grip, Father grabbed Itsuki by the collar and pointed his shield at him. Then, the spikes on Father’s shield sharpened sharply and pierced Itsuki.
“Guh…”
However, they didn’t penetrate Itsuki deeply. At most, he probably sustained only minor damage.
“Ugh… what is this…”

Itsuki placed a hand on his head as if feeling dizzy. Without hesitation, Father pushed Itsuki to the ground and pinned him down so he couldn’t move. It wasn’t a joint lock; he simply sat on top of Itsuki to prevent him from getting up or doing anything. This looks familiar.

That’s the same attack he used on me. It was Father’s scheme—he’d been relentlessly targeting my face and groin… Ah, I don’t think it’s just my imagination that I’m starting to get a little excited. At the sight of Father’s heroic stance, I, Motoyasu, can’t see a thing through my tears.
“Well then, if you surrender now, I’ll let you off.”
“W-who would ever surrender!”
“I see… Then I’ll just keep pinning you down until you do.”
“Hmph. No matter what Naofumi the Shield does, my victory is unshakable!”
“We’ll see how long you can keep saying that.”

Itsuki tries several times to cast Skills at my Father, but due to his position, he seems unable to do anything. I was in the same situation back then, too. Even when I tried to break free from his grip using brute force, my Father was surprisingly strong, and I couldn’t do a thing. At first glance, it looks like my father-in-law is pinning Itsuki down and the fight is going to drag on… but I don’t think that’s the case.
“Ugh… ugh…”

Itsuki’s resistance is gradually slowing down. As Itsuki tries to concentrate and cast Magic, my father-in-law covers his mouth with his hand and, at the same time, disrupts his concentration with another counterattack from his shield against the struggling Itsuki.
“Whoa, can you even use Magic right now? Well, it looks like this counterattack effect has nullified your Magic, anyway.”

Presumably, the shield that Father is using has additional effects like poison, paralysis, or silence. After that, the poison will slowly chip away at Itsuki’s HP, and the paralysis or silence will leave him unable to even put up a fight. Good grief… If my father had possessed a shield of that sort, I would have been completely defeated when I fought him—even without the Crimson Swine’s cheating.
This is how the Shield Hero fights… It’s magnificent. Motoyasu here—I can’t stop crying at the sight of my father’s heroic figure.
“Spear Guy, stop crying in that creepy way.”
“He’s just very emotional. Lord Motoyasu is deeply moved by Lord Naofumi’s heroic display.”
“I get where he’s coming from, but—Bro, you’re awesome!”

Itsuki’s movements were gradually slowing down, and just as I thought the battle was about to end… with a *thwack*, Father’s cloak fluttered unnaturally. Well, actually, it was obvious to everyone what had happened even before it fluttered.

Sure enough, the Crimson Swine, blending into the crowd, cast the wind Magic “Wing Blow” at my Father. But this time, my Father isn’t scraping by with barely enough level and gear like I was. I could tell the Magic hit, but he didn’t even flinch.

My Father was completely unscathed. Noticing the incoming Magic, he glared at the Crimson Swine with obvious displeasure. The referee is completely turning a blind eye to this. Or rather, he looks like he’s flustered because the spell isn’t having any effect.
“Everyone, save the Bow Hero from the shield!”
The moment that Trash made that declaration, the mages surrounding the crowd began chanting their spells.
“Wha… don’t mess with me!”
Each mage fired a spell at my Father. Fire, wind, earth, water, lightning, light… all sorts of Magic flies toward my Father. But just as it’s about to hit…
“Shooting Star Shield!”
“Whoa—”

Itsuki is crushed by the Shooting Star Shield my Father unleashed and is completely immobilized. The mages’ Magic strikes the barrier my Father created, sending plumes of smoke billowing into the air.
“Hey!”

Ren, who had been watching from a short distance away, rushes over to Trash and Crimson Swine. It’s probably better to have Ren confront them rather than me—I’ve already made a bad impression here. I’ll make them taste the terror of seeing everything go wrong because of their own actions.
“What are you doing! In a fair one-on-one duel, why are the princess’s support Magic spells and the castle’s mages attacking Naofumi?!”
“The Shield Hero used poison—a despicable attack. Therefore, the outcome of this match is already decided: victory belongs to the Bow Hero!”
“Poison attacks are a perfectly valid strategy! Otherwise, Naofumi—who has so few means of attack—would have virtually no chance of winning!”
Ren draws his sword and glares at Trash and Crimson Swine, ready to fight at a moment’s notice.
“Stop attacking Naofumi right now. This match is invalid because of you two… No, wait. No matter how you look at it, Naofumi has won!”
“But the Shield Hero hindered the Bow Hero’s movements through underhanded means! That doesn’t make for a legitimate duel!”
“You didn’t state any such rules at the start! Is your idea of a duel just a public execution?!”
Even Ren, for all his composure, is shouting without hiding his anger. However, it looks like Trash is going to keep making excuses until the bitter end.
“Boo!”
Crimson Swine, with tears in his eyes, lunges toward Ren. But Ren points his sword at Crimson Swine and warns him not to come any closer.
“Know your limits, for heaven’s sake. You cowardly cast Magic while hiding among the crowd, and now you’re claiming it was a misunderstanding? That’s a stretch!”
“Bububububu…”
“You say you couldn’t bear to see Itsuki on the verge of losing? Even so, this is unacceptable! Princess, make him stop right now! Itsuki has lost!”
Looking incredibly annoyed, Trash raises his hand to order the Magic user to stop the attack. Itsuki seems to be pinned down by the Shooting Star Shield cast by his Father and can’t even move.
“I’m surprised… So? Can I count this as a win for me?”
“I-I’m not… I haven’t… lost yet.”
“You sure have the nerve to say that in that condition. I guess that’s what makes you a hero, huh?”
“Too bad, but it’s the Princess and the King’s fault you lost. Besides, if things keep going like this, the poison’s going to take You down anyway.”
“Guh… ugh…”

The utterly exhausted Itsuki seems to have completely lost consciousness. Father waited until he determined Itsuki could no longer continue fighting before moving to release him. The kingdom’s mages and soldiers rushed over to Itsuki and cast healing and antidote spells on him.
“Is this okay now?”
“Gnu…”
“Bub…”

Trash and Crimson Swine groaned in frustration. Ren’s suspicious gaze is growing stronger. Frankly, any more absurd claims will only fuel his suspicion even further. Though I have a feeling it’s already too late. The atmosphere around us seems to have turned very tense.
“Once Itsuki regains consciousness, make sure to explain things clearly to it. You lost to Naofumi. Also, since Naofumi’s slave seems to genuinely care for him, don’t try to force them apart.”
It seems Ren has the most influence here. There’s no need for me to step in.
